name: Custom Destination
shortInfo: Send data to any Destination that supports a Writeback
brief: The Custom Destination Reverse ETL connector is a generic all-purpose sync which can be used with any REST API friendly data destination to efficiently Reverse ETL data.
about: Push data to any REST API friendly data destination through this Custom Reverse connector. It enables streaming of relevant data syncs from a user determined data warehouse automatically once you configure the custom syncs.
availableSync:
[Load](https://docs.datachannel.co/getting-started/1.0.0/reverse_etl/destinations_retl/custom-destination/syncs/load.html)

This sync can be used to load data from your data warehouse into any REST API friendly data destination.
